Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from the first Super Four game of the 2025 Asia Cup and it is Bangladesh who have given themselves a wonderful opportunity to make a claim for a spot in the Final. Still, early days in this phase of the competition and up next is take two of the monumental clash that the cricketing world has been waiting for. India face Pakistan here in Dubai on Sunday, 21 September and that game will begin at 8 pm IST (2.30 pm GMT). But as usual, you can join us a lot sooner for the build-up as well. Till then, take care and goodbye!

The skipper of Bangladesh, Litton Das, says that before the Asia Cup, they played a lot of matches and he feels like they were pretty comfortable in chasing. Also says that they all believed in Saif Hassan and they are really blessed to have a player like him. Ends up saying that now their focus is on the next match and he hopes that they keep their momentum.

The captain of Sri Lanka, Charith Asalanka, says that it was a terrific game where they, as a team, held their nerves till the end but it was not enough. Shares that he is pleased about the batting effort but could have done better in the last two overs. Believes that they were 10-15 runs short. Praises Dasun Shanaka for the way he batted, having been sent at number 5. Mentions that the spirits were high in the camp at the halfway mark as they were aiming 170 at the start of the game and they almost got there.

Saif Hassan wins the Player of the Match. He says that the ball was coming nicely to the bat and he just tried to time his shots. Also says that his skipper, Litton Das, helped him a lot to guide him throughout the inning. He also shares that he feels really happy to contribute to the team. Ends up saying that the preparation was good and they executed their plan properly.
The Presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Litton Das put Sri Lanka into bat, which seemed to have backfired a bit as the Lankan openers got off to a flying start. Pathum Nissanka and Kusal Mendis put on 44 runs inside 5 overs before Nissanka got out. Bangladesh then did well to stem the flow of runs after the Powerplay. Sri Lanka kept on losing wickets in the middle overs before finally Dasun Shanaka and Charith Asalanka led the fightback. The former Lankan skipper was in a devastating mood as he hit 6 biggies in his unbeaten knock of 64 off just 37 balls. As for Bangladesh, Mustafizur Rahman was outstanding, picking up 3 for 20 as Mahedi also contributed with 2 wickets and an economical spell.

Sri Lanka had a perfect record in the initial group stage of the competition and had brushed aside Bangladesh in their previous encounter but will now face an uphill task if they are to qualify for the final. Nuwan Thushara did provide them with the perfect start as well but the early wicket wasn't followed by a sustained spell of pressure. Wanindu Hasaranga did his best to bring his side back into the game in the middle phase with a couple of wickets but again, that fifth bowler was the issue for the Lankans. They had to use Dasun Shanaka extensively and even Kamindu Mendis, who bowled just one over but an expensive one.

Chasing 169 for the win, Bangladesh lost Tanzid Hasan for a duck in the very first over but then came the counter-punch from Saif Hassan. Litton Das provided good support before getting out but Saif carried on and brought up a half-century. He too got out but Bangladesh were carried forward by Tawhid Hridoy, who played the telling knock and he too scored a fifty. With just 10 runs needed for the win, Hridoy got out and failed to take his team over the line but he had done enough. There were a couple of nervy moments in the final over, though.

THE BANGLA TIGERS ROAR! They have taken revenge for that resounding loss in the previous stage of the competition against Sri Lanka and have kick-started the Super Four stage with a crucial win. It seemed to be one of Bangladesh's more clinical wins but there was some drama in the final over. Amidst all the chaos, Shamim Hossain kept his cool and made sure his team didn't fumble it right at the death.

Bangladesh get over the line in a nervy fashion! Shamim Hossain was gone had the throw hit. On a back of a length from around the wicket, outside off. Nasum waits back and taps the ball on its head. Directs it towards the man at gully and he is called through for a single by Hossain. The ball goes straight to the gully fielder, who collects it calmly and has a shy at the batting end but misses. Hossain leaps in delight after completing the winning run.

OUT! TAKEN! Instant impact from Wanindu Hasaranga! Pitches it up, touch fuller, on middle. Litton Das gets down on his one knee and reaches out in front for the sweep. The ball balloons towards deep backward square leg off a top edge, where Pathum Nissanka judges the skier well and pouches it safely into his hands.
Commentary.Howout: c Pathum Nissanka b Wanindu Hasaranga
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.3: Wanindu Hasaranga to Litton Das, OUT! c Pathum Nissanka b Wanindu Hasaranga.

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, outside off. Saif Hassan presses forward to drive it toward long off for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.2: Wanindu Hasaranga to Saif Hassan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Googly, short of a length, on off. Saif Hassan makes room and dabs it back to the bowler.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.1: Wanindu Hasaranga to Saif Hassan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Wanindu Hasaranga comes into the attack right after the Powerplay.
FOUR! This is terrific batting from Litton Das! Short of a length, wide outside off. Litton Das trusts the width of the delivery and lashes it through the cover region for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.6: Dushmantha Chameera to Litton Das, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, just outside off. Litton Das shuffles across the stumps to scoop it but misses the connection.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.5: Dushmantha Chameera to Litton Das, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Easy pickings for Litton Das! Pitches it up, on middle and leg. Litton Das puts on his dancing shoes and skips down the track. He uses his bottom hand and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.4: Dushmantha Chameera to Litton Das, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: 50 runs partnership for these two batters! Short, on the stump. Saif Hassan hangs back and mistimes his pull toward square leg for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.3: Dushmantha Chameera to Saif Hassan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, on middle, shaping it in. Litton Das rocks back to punch it away but gets nicked on the inner edge and the ball bounces toward short fine leg. Single taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.2: Dushmantha Chameera to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good-length delivery, on middle. Saif Hassan tucks it toward deep square leg for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.1: Dushmantha Chameera to Saif Hassan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Dushmantha Chameera is back on to close out the Powerplay. He went for 8 runs in his first over.

Bashes the hard length, outside off. Hassan hangs back, taps the ball on its head and gets it wide of backward point. Wanindu Hasaranga gives it a chase, turns around and fires an accurate throw towards the batting end but cannot stop the batters from taking the third run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.6: Nuwan Thushara to Saif Hassan, 3 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten! This is pace on and it skids through, outside off. Saif looks to run it down but is beaten for pace.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.5: Nuwan Thushara to Saif Hassan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Excellent wristwork! Nuwan slips a full ball on the pads. Saif's head falls over to the off side as he looks to whip it away. Lifts his back leg whilst playing the pick-up shot and deposits it over deep mid-wicket for a six.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.4: Nuwan Thushara to Saif Hassan, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Takes pace off and goes full, on off. Das backs away and goes over the top on the off side. Dunith Wellalage goes after it and hauls it in with a slide. Flicks the ball towards Kamil Mishara, who is backing him up. Three runs taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.3: Nuwan Thushara to Litton Das, 3 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Bangs it into the deck, over middle. This comes at chest height and Hassan pulls it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Nuwan Thushara to Saif Hassan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a hard length, on off, Litton hits it on the rise to the right of cover for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Nuwan Thushara to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short and this skids through. Litton backs away but Dunith follows him. Hits it down to long off for one more.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Dunith Wellalage to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and quicker, on middle and leg, Saif nudges it in front of deep mid-wicket for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Dunith Wellalage to Saif Hassan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Does not offer flight this time and it is pushed through, on the pads. Saif tucks it to backward square leg.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Dunith Wellalage to Saif Hassan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Launched down the ground! Tossed up by Dunith from around the wicket, on a length, on middle. Saif Hassan advances down the track and goes down the ground. Hits it towards the sight screen for a six.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Dunith Wellalage to Saif Hassan, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Litton backs away and Dunith does well to follow him. This is flat and short and Das works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Dunith Wellalage to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Angled into the pads, Saif clips this full ball in the vacant mid-wicket region for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Dunith Wellalage to Saif Hassan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Time for spin as Dunith Wellalage has now been tossed the ball.
Off-pace delivery but this is full and it drops on the batter. Litton watchfully keeps it out on the off side.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Nuwan Thushara to Litton Das, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! 14 runs of the over with a ball to go. Nuwan goes short but takes pace off. Saif Hassan lets it through as the ball sails over his head. The ball bounces in front of the keeper and deflects off his pads towards short third. It allows the batters to take a quick run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Nuwan Thushara to Saif Hassan, 2 Wides!

Commentary.Commentary: Loopy slower one, on the fuller side, around off. Saif checks the drive and plays a bit uppishly in front of mid off.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Nuwan Thushara to Saif Hassan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Missed out! Too straight from Thushara, on the pads, Litton tickles but fails to get it wide enough of the man at short fine leg. It goes straight towards the man there and Das crosses over for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Nuwan Thushara to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: At 119.9 kph, off-pace delivery, on a good length, Saif nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Nuwan Thushara to Saif Hassan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! All the way! This is on a length, on middle. Hassan skips down the track and brings his bottom hand into play. Whips it over the man at mid on and clears the fence for a flat six.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Nuwan Thushara to Saif Hassan, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Smashed! Pitched up at 134.3 kph, a bit of away shape, on off. Saif stays leg side of the ball and slams it back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Nuwan Thushara to Saif Hassan, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: This is the leg cutter from Chameera, on a short of a length, steered down to deep third for another single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Dushmantha Chameera to Saif Hassan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Hurls it on the off pole, on a good length, Das plays a punchy drive wide of cover for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Dushmantha Chameera to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: At 144.1 kph, on a hard length, on off. Saif gets on top of it and punches it in front of backward point for one more.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Dushmantha Chameera to Saif Hassan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Honing in on the stumps, on a good length. Litton walks across for the scoop but miscues it off a leading edge. It rolls behind square on the off side for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Dushmantha Chameera to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Flayed away! Fractionally short, outside off. Litton arches back and slaps it over the cover-point fielder for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Dushmantha Chameera to Litton Das, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Hurls it on a good length, around off, Das dabs it to backward point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Dushmantha Chameera to Litton Das, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Dushmantha Chameera will steam in from the other end.
Nuwan nails the yorker, on middle. Litton gets his bat down and digs it out in front of mid on. Pinches a quick single to get off the mark.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Nuwan Thushara to Litton Das, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: The captain of Bangladesh, Litton Das is in at number 3.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Tanzid has been completely outfoxed by Thushara! Nuwan rolls his fingers on top of the ball and lands it on a good length, on the off stump. Hasan premeditates as he gives the bowler the charge. He swings to go down the ground but is deceived by the slower one and plays down the wrong line. The ball sneaks past the inside edge and clatters into the off pole.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Nuwan Thushara to Tanzid Hasan, OUT! b Nuwan Thushara.

Commentary.Commentary: Goes full, tailing in at the toes, Tanzid jams it out towards mid-wicket.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Nuwan Thushara to Tanzid Hasan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Drags the length back, outside off, Hassan looks to punch it away but ends up chopping it down beside the strip on the off side for a single. Bangladesh are underway in the chase!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Nuwan Thushara to Saif Hassan, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Goes full and finds a bit of away shape, outside off. Saif mistimes the drive back towards the bowler.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Nuwan Thushara to Saif Hassan, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Starts on the money! On a good length, in the channel on off, Saif presses forward and taps it to cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Nuwan Thushara to Saif Hassan, No run.
